| # BDL API {#bdl-api-1 .p_Heading1 style="page-break-after: avoid;"} |                                                                                                                                           |
+---------------------------------------------------------------------+-------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------+

 

 

All the BDL APIs that are needed for the ASW development are packed in a separate CODESYS library , each sensor has its own library that can be added to CODESYS library repository. BODAS_RC18-12_27-18_40_xx.library is a part of BODAS-RTS package and can be found in myBODAS build download folder in directory  - BODAS-RTS/CodesysImports/.

 

The documentation of each API can be seen in the corresponding documentation tab of each API
